name: nexora-invoicepro
description: Invoice and billing management system for Nexora Technologies

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @nexora/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,cyan "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nexora/shared && npm run build -w @nexora/server && npm run build -w @nexora/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @nexora/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @nexora/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
